text:
You can now build custom themes for Claude Code on desktop with mods! Change the colors, add an animated background, and make it your own.

Just tell Claude how you want it to look, or get started quickly with the theme-examples plugin. We'd love to see what you make! https://t.co/kD4fxkk6Df
